Bowling

  1. Three taps per ball. First, tap to stop the bowler where you want to stand. Then tap to lock the aim as the arrow sweeps. Then tap to lock the spin as the hook swings left and right.
  2. The dotted line shows where the ball will go. Spin bends it late, near the pins. Yellow dots mean the gutter.
  3. The best way in is the pocket: just beside the head pin, coming in at an angle.
  4. Ten frames. A strike scores 10 plus your next two balls; a spare, 10 plus your next ball. A perfect game is 300.
